tagline: 雅西卡便携相机，1986 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1986年推出的便携相机。配备Carl Zeiss T* (coated) 35mm f/3.5 lens (Tessar with 4 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度1/8-1/500s。使用Automatic motorwind.。感光度Automatic DX-decoding of ISO 50-1600 film.。1m to infinity with focus lock.。

specs.镜头: Carl Zeiss T* (coated) 35mm f/3.5 lens (Tessar with 4 elements in 3 groups)
specs.曝光测光: Programmed autoexposure system with SPD sensor.
specs.闪光灯: Automatic firing in low light (flashmatic type--full power, aperture changes according to focus distance). Range 1-2.5m (ISO 100) with daylight fill-in.
specs.电池: 6V 2CR5 lithium battery capable of 1000 frames (50% with flash), equivalent to about 40 rolls of 24 exposure film.
specs.英文简介: The Yashica T2 (also known as the Kyocera T) was a 35mm compact camera from Kyocera with a high-quality lens.
